test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Akshay wants to buy a 6 m wide cloth to make a conical tent having a radius of 12 m and height of 35 m. How many metres of cloth does he need to buy? Take pi = (22)/(7) Note: Round off the decimals to the nearest whole number.
solution:
**Given:**

Cloth width = 6 m

Tent radius (r) = 12 m

Tent height (h) = 35 m

**Formula Used:**

Slant height of cone (l) = √(r² + h²)

Curved surface area of cone = π × r × l

Length of cloth = Curved surface area / Cloth width

**Calculation:**

Slant height (l) = √(12² + 35²)

l = √(144 + 1225)

l = √1369 ⇒ l = 37 m

Curved surface area = (22/7) × 12 × 37

Curved surface area = 9768 / 7 ≈ 1395.43 m²

Length of cloth = 1395.43 / 6

⇒ Length of cloth ≈ 232.57 m

Rounding off to the nearest whole number, length of cloth ≈ 233 m

**∴ Akshay needs to buy approximately 233 metres of cloth.**
